accepted_elements: Owner-only directories require searchable mode 0700 while sensitive regular files require 0600.
The exact runner stdout and stderr paths must be proven creatable before supervisor or Chrome spawn.
No browser, Hub, keychain or r7 runtime action occurred during the source-only correction.

blocking_findings.evidence: createRunnerOutput uses writeFile with flag w and does not first require runner.stdout and runner.stderr to be absent.
blocking_findings.impact: A repeated preflight on a stale or consumed root can silently truncate prior runner evidence instead of failing closed.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Require both output paths absent and create each with exclusive flag wx.

blocking_findings.evidence: The preflight checks only control.sock and the three ports, then chmods any existing supervisor-state.json and browser-control-events.jsonl and recursively normalizes existing directories.
blocking_findings.impact: A stale or consumed runtime tree can be made to look prepared rather than rejected before mutation.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Before chmod or file creation, require all runtime state, event log, profiles, certificate export, witness, acceptance receipt and runner-output paths absent.

blocking_findings.evidence: The test proves only one successful invocation and file modes. It does not test a second invocation, sentinel preservation, or stale state/event/profile rejection before mutation.
blocking_findings.impact: The destructive and stale-root cases are unguarded.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Add no-network tests proving second invocation fails without changing sentinel bytes and every stale artifact class fails before mutation.

next_gate: Supply an additive source-only superseding preflight and tests that satisfy all three findings. The consumed r6 tree remains non-reusable and cannot become a fresh preparation by chmod or cleanup.
proof_boundary: This review rejects future-runtime readiness. It is not browser, SDK API, TLS, CORS, Hub API, installation, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance evidence.
